user.title: Pstryk UPS AI Optimizer — API Keys
user.description: Enter your Pstryk and Claude API keys. Both are required for the integration to function.

data_description.pstryk_api_key: Your Pstryk electricity pricing API token. Obtain it from the Pstryk customer portal.
data_description.claude_api_key: Your Anthropic API key for the Claude AI model. Obtain it from console.anthropic.com.

ups_config.title: UPS Parameters
ups_config.description: Describe your UPS battery system so Claude can calculate accurate charge/discharge plans.

data_description.ups_model: A descriptive name for your UPS (e.g. 'SolarEdge 10kWh').
data_description.battery_capacity_kwh: Total usable battery capacity across all strings.
data_description.num_strings: Number of parallel battery strings in your system.
data_description.max_charge_rate_kw: Maximum power at which the UPS can charge the battery.
data_description.max_discharge_rate_kw: Maximum power the UPS can supply from the battery.
data_description.battery_min_pct: Never discharge the battery below this level (reserve). Sent to Claude for planning.
data_description.battery_max_pct: Never charge the battery above this level. Sent to Claude for planning.

mqtt_schedule.title: MQTT Topics & Scheduling
mqtt_schedule.description: Configure MQTT topics for power monitoring and UPS charge/discharge control.

data_description.mqtt_power_topic: MQTT topic publishing current power draw in kW. Accepts plain numeric or JSON payload.
data_description.mqtt_history_topic: MQTT topic publishing historical kWh consumption as JSON ({"daily": {...}, "hourly": {...}}).
data_description.mqtt_charge_topic: MQTT topic to which '1' (start charging) or '0' (stop charging) is published.
data_description.mqtt_discharge_topic: MQTT topic to which '1' (start discharging) or '0' (stop discharging) is published.
data_description.mqtt_battery_topic: MQTT topic publishing battery state of charge in percent.
data_description.refresh_interval_hours: How often (in hours) to fetch new electricity prices from Pstryk.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure API Keys
reconfigure.description: Update your Pstryk or Claude API keys.
